   217→    def compose_conf_value(self, other):
   218→        """
   219→        self has precedence, the "other" will add/append if possible and not conflicting, but
   220→        self mandates what to do. If self has define(), without placeholder, that will remain.

   241→        elif self._value is None or other._value is None:

   297→

   299→        :param default: Default value in case of conf does not have the conf_name key.
   300→        :param check_type: Check the conf type(value) is the same as the given by this param.

    base = os.path.join(client.current_folder, "build", token)
    if include_release_subdir:

    else:

def _assert_tokens_in_order(name, tokens):
    # assert tokens appear in order, lowercased
    pos = -1

        tok = tok.lower()
        new_pos = name.lower().find(tok, pos + 1)
        assert new_pos != -1, f"token '{tok}' not found in preset name '{name}'"
